description: Size a position the way a risk manager would: fixed-fractional risk to a stop, volatility targeting (ATR or annualized vol), or fractional Kelly from your edge statistics. Applies a max-position cap and round lots, and explains the binding constraint. Price: $0.005.

annual_vol.description: volatility: annualized volatility of the asset (e.g. 0.35).

atr.description: volatility: average true range in price units.

atr_multiple.description: volatility: stop distance in ATRs, default 2.

avg_loss.description: kelly: average loss as a positive number.

avg_win.description: kelly: average win (any unit, same as avg_loss).

kelly_fraction.description: kelly: fraction of full Kelly to use, default 0.25.

lot_size.description: Round down to this multiple, default 1.

max_position_pct.description: Cap on position value / equity, default 0.2.

risk_pct.description: fixed_fractional: fraction of equity to risk, default 0.01.

target_annual_vol_contribution.description: volatility: target vol contribution as fraction of equity, default 0.02.

name: position_size
title: Position sizing
